name: OB-Xd
author: sd88me/mpc-vst-plugins port; engine by Filatov Vadim (2DaT), discoDSP and the OB-Xd community
summary: OB-Xd Oberheim-style virtual analog polysynth (unofficial port): 8 voices, all 77 parameters, full-screen touch panel, BANK / PATCH selector reading .fxb banks from a folder, FREQUENCY (Hz) tuning and a STOP button.
